technical.summary: Short-term bullish setup with golden cross and three white soldiers, but overbought conditions and price below 200-SMA limit conviction; suitable for swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 100 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 30) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed/neutral with only junior-level trades in modest amounts, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (306.7) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 100 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + AO cross-up provide short-term bullish momentum setup in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 99.92 with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought technicals (RSI 74, Stoch 87), price below 200-SMA and Ichimoku cloud, inverted yield curve recession signal, earnings event risk in 100 days, and zero fundamental/institutional support create a weak conviction setup with macro headwinds overwhelming short-term signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and three white soldiers provide short-term bullish setup in extreme fear environment, but overbought technicals (RSI 74, Stoch 87) combined with price below 200-SMA and Ichimoku cloud severely limit conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve recession signal, earnings event risk in 100 days, and macro headwinds (VIX crisis, unfavourable environment) create elevated downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum signals.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all flag significant concerns; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
